sections.advice: Davos → Fluela Pass climbs about 2383 m in 11 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Fluela Pass → Bernina Pass is 49 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Bernina Pass → St Moritz drops about 2330 m over 21 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
St Moritz → Bellinzona is 88 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-davos-bellinzo.story: A 186 km one-way ride from near Davos, about 3 h 01 of riding. It goes by way of Fluela Pass, Bernina Pass and St Moritz. The highest point is about 2,500 m. Fluela Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Tatra Foothills Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 42 km this is Tatra Foothills Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-bardejov-town-conservation-reserv.story: A 365 km round trip from Bardejov - roughly 6 h 18 in the saddle. On the way it passes Powroźnik-Tserkva of Saint James the Less, Owczary-Tserkva of Our Lady’s Protection, Church of St Leonard and Church of the Archangel Michael. The highest point is about 800 m. It crosses from Slovakia into Poland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
